aboutMe.intro: Hey, I'm Roxana – I bring your videos and ideas to life!
aboutMe.text1: As a passionate video editor and cutter, I have a fine sense for timing, rhythm, and emotion.
aboutMe.text2: With these skills, I transform your raw footage into captivating stories.
aboutMe.text3: Do you need an atmospheric video of your last trip, one or more YouTube videos, or professional social media posts for your Instagram or TikTok?
aboutMe.text4: I deliver precisely edited content with style and structure.
aboutMe.skill2: Precision and efficiency in video editing
aboutMe.skill3: Creative ideas for visual effects and transitions
aboutMe.skill4: Fast, intuitive workflow with DaVinci Resolve
aboutMe.skill6: Attention to detail and high quality standards
aboutMe.ctaText: If you'd like me to edit your next video, write to me.
aboutMe.ctaText2: I look forward to working with you!
